name: UpdateFile
description: Updates or renames a file in Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and update files in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to update (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: New File Name
fields.description: The new name for the file. The file will be renamed to this value while keeping the same folder location.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns metadata of the updated file, including ID, new name, URL, and properties.
